# Fixture used by the test suite and the CI smoke test.
#
# The interesting part is that "Allow: /docs" (5 characters) beats
# "Disallow: /" (1 character) for the wildcard group, while the named
# "testbot" group is selected instead of the wildcard for that product token.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /
Allow: /docs
Crawl-delay: 1

User-agent: testbot
Disallow: /docs/private
Allow: /docs/private/faq
Crawl-delay: 0.5

Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml
